props.name: ariaControls
props.description:
Aria Controls attribute
- Dynamically set for A11y

props.name: ariaLabelledBy
props.description:
Aria Labelled By attribute
- Dynamically set for A11y

props.name: idx
props.description:
Index of the panel
- Dynamically set by the ALAccordion

props.name: isActive
props.description:
Active property
1. Panel is open when set to true. Close when set to false

props.name: isLast
props.description:
Is last?
- Dynamically set by the ALAccordion
- Removes the bottom border if it is the last item

events.name: onAccordionPanelClose
events.description: Fired when the panel collapses. Detail: `{ index, expanded }` — the panel's index within the accordion and its new expanded state.

events.name: onAccordionPanelOpen
events.description: Fired when the panel expands. Detail: `{ index, expanded }` — the panel's index within the accordion and its new expanded state.
